### Meaning
| infl.      | class        | meaning                                                        |
| ---------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ~          | *n.*         | rotation, spin, turn / encircling, surrounding / circumference |
| ~en        | *v.*         | to rotate (intr.) / to encircle, to surround (tr.)             |
| ...thu ~en | *v. caus.*   | to rotate (tr.)                                                |
| ~un        | *adv.*       | around                                                         |
### Implied meaning
- cycle, loop
- repetition, re-
### Note
*for "loop/circle", see [[kon'tsen\|kon'tsen]]/[[Sen'fi/Excalidraw/Geometry/ksoqi\|ksoqi]]; for "cycle" see [[tsen'zha\|tsen'zha]].*
*warning: potential ambiguity between physical and temporal cycles.*
### Etymology
#### Glyph
回, an object rotating within another; a swirl
==speen== 🌀🍥💫
#### Sound
- *a priori:* ts=repetition, en=process
